description: RedLineBench measures the tension between offensive-cybersecurity capability and AI safety alignment: for any LLM it separately scores refusal (does it decline a cyber request) and capability (when it answers, is the answer technically valid and usable) across 153 grounded single-turn offensive-security tasks.
